## Notification history (US-028)

Signed-in customers can view and filter their recent notifications (large transaction, low balance, bill reminder).

- Screen: `/notification-history.html?from=dashboard|security-center|bill-payments&lang=de|fr|it|en`
- API: `GET /api/v1/notifications/history?types=LOW_BALANCE&lang=de&tz=Europe/Zurich&from=dashboard` (JWT bearer with `customerId` claim)
- Labels: `GET /api/v1/notifications/history/labels?lang=fr` (public)

### Build and test

```bash
cd banking-core-service
mvn clean verify
mvn clean package -DskipTests
```

### Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_RETENTION` | `90d` | Retention window; older notifications are hidden and purged |
| `NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_DEFAULT_TZ` | `Europe/Zurich` | Time zone used when the client sends none |
| `NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_PURGE_CRON` | `0 30 2 * * *` | Schedule of the retention purge job |

See `banking-core-service/.env.example` for database and JWT settings.
